messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear AMBER community,
To get the total electrostatic energy from ESANDER output, do I need to sum the [elec] and [elec14] columns? Or, is the [elec14] contribution already included in the [elec] data?
Best,
Matthew
